subject: 162 Mystic Avenue Retail Marijuana Special Permit
overview: The board approved a special permit and site plan for a retail marijuana dispensary and community arts center at 162 Mystic Avenue with several conditions. Several other petitions were continued to the September meeting or withdrawn after receiving building permits by right.

items.title: 5 Russell Street (Case A-2022-10)
items.summary: This case was withdrawn after the building department determined the requested relief for a garage renovation was available by right, and a permit has already been issued.

items.title: Zero Bailey Street (Case A-2022-11)
items.summary: Continued the hearing to the September 29 meeting at the request of the applicant.

items.title: 595 Broadway (Case A-2022-12)
items.summary: Continued the petition to the next regular meeting to allow the applicant time to incorporate design changes recommended by the Community Development Board.

items.title: Marijuana Ordinance Overview
items.summary: Attorney Jonathan Silverstein provided a high-level briefing on the city's cannabis zoning ordinance, special permit criteria, and the host community agreement process.

items.title: 162 Mystic Avenue (Case SP-2022-01)
items.summary: Approved the special permit and site plan for Theory Wellness to operate a retail marijuana dispensary and a 10,000-square-foot community arts center. Approval includes conditions for police sign-off on the security plan, funding a public mural, and coordinating site signage with the arts collaborative.

items.title: Administrative Updates and Approval of Minutes
items.summary: Discussed the draft comprehensive plan and zoning recommendations and approved the meeting minutes from July 28, 2022.
